s.note: Coach Boone's training camp at Gettysburg
s.how: Whisk 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp dried oregano and pepper. Split 2 long baguettes and drizzle the insides with half the dressing. Layer with 150g sliced ham, 100g salami and 100g provolone. Top with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, thin red onion and pickled peppers, then the rest of the dressing. Press closed, wrap tightly for 10 minutes and cut each into 4.

s.note: Friday night football in Alexandria, Virginia
s.how: Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp chilli powder, 200g passata and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Grill 8 frankfurts for 6 minutes. Toast 8 hot dog buns. Fill each with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli, scatter with 120g grated cheddar and grill 2 minutes to melt. Top with diced white onion and mustard.

m.note: the Titans' left side, strong side
m.how: Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces in 400ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp hot sauce for at least 2 hours. Toss in 200g plain flour mixed with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and salt. Fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until golden and cooked through. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with butter and milk. Make gravy with 30g butter, 2 tbsp flour, 400ml milk and lots of pepper. Warm 3 tbsp honey with chilli flakes.

w.how: Toss 2 x 820g tins drained sliced peaches with 60g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tbsp cornflour and a squeeze of lemon and tip into a baking dish. Rub 80g cold butter into 200g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp sugar, then stir in 150ml buttermilk. Drop spoonfuls over the peaches and sprinkle with 1 tbsp sugar mixed with cinnamon. Bake at 190C for 30 minutes until golden. Serve warm with ice cream.

d.note: Sunshine and the hot Southern summer
d.how: Steep 6 black tea bags in 700ml boiling water with 80g sugar for 5 minutes, then remove the bags and chill. Stir 80g sugar into the juice of 5 lemons and 500ml cold water until dissolved. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour in the tea to halfway and top with the lemonade. Garnish with lemon wheels and mint.
